ABIS is named only as flagging register records; no government AI use is described.

Only SERAP's claim of NDPC's statutory powers; no appointment or ruling stated.

facts.fact: SERAP's suit treats the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 as the law now binding INEC and the NDPC, citing its sections 24, 39, 40 and 65.
SERAP reports INEC's Automated Biometric Identification System flagged 268 records in the preliminary Register of Voters.
INEC published the preliminary Register of Voters on its website and displayed it physically nationwide from 9 to 15 October 2026, when questionable records were flagged.

NGA.note: Document concerns the voters' register, not the national ID system.
